Game Overview

Chimney Express puts players into a christmas experience centered on join Santa in a festive frenzy as he blasts presents into chimneys with a cannon. Tackle 20 delightful levels, perfecting your aim and timing to ensure every child awakens to Christmas joy. Can you deliver all the gifts before morning breaks? Experience the magic and fun in Chimney Express!
